highest-timestamp-object.rule: object of highest-tick initial row (tie last row) or ! if null

last-row-object.rule: object of last serialized initial row or ! if null

nearest-to-query-object.rule: object of row 0 adjacent to query header or ! if null

oracle-traversal.rule: privileged evaluator oracle using Truth (not a shortcut)

random-legal.rule: uniform SHA256-seeded choice over legal actions

limitations: Recorded raw actions replayed through source parser and public environment; no neural inference or checkpoint restoration.
Model call counts and positions are recorded telemetry, not independently reconstructed.
Archive hashes establish internal integrity, not independent provenance.
T0 raw predictions and full checkpoints are not exported in these archives.
Sidecar argmax comparison is limited to first-token base logits; fail logits are inventoried and checked finite.
